incident-bot: Paging: org=tidalwave high error spike in us-west-2 — 22% 5xx, queueing increased, autoscaler failing. https://in.ci/incident/1812345679 :rotating_light:
maya-oncall: Oncall here. I see sustained qps spike + KV cache churn. p99 token latency ~1200ms, p50 320ms.
raj-sre: Confirmed. Per-org qps limit 250 being hit, requests queuing and hitting enqueue timeout. Logs: "enqueue timeout after 300ms".
maya-oncall: Proposal: temp raise soft qps for tidalwave to 350 for 15m, enable traffic shaping to warm pool. Keep canary rollback in 30m. Anyone object? :eyes:
sam-platform: +1. I'll prepare hotpatch. Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching bypass to reduce cache misses for that org.
maya-oncall: Applying hotpatch now:
```bash
rictl org update --org tidalwave --qps 350 --ttl 900 --reason "emergency spike 2026-03-17"
```
maya-oncall: Patch applied, API returned 200. Monitoring metrics.
ops-bot: Alert: 5xx rate dropped from 22% -> 4% in 45s. Forwarding graphs to thread. :thumbsup:
lina-support: Notifying CS (channel #cs-tidalwave) and sending interim customer update: "We're seeing a traffic spike; applied temporary rate adjustment to keep service healthy. Monitoring closely." ETA to follow.
raj-sre: Leave auto-rollback canary: schedule rollback in 30m if p99 < 600ms and 5xx < 1%. If not, escalate and extend in 15m increments. Also file follow-up to review per-org quotas & billing impact.
maya-oncall: Acknowledge. Handoff note: oncall @raj-sre will own the next 45m. Adding runbook entry and incident tag. :white_check_mark:
sam-platform: Logged playbook steps in incident ticket and added CLI command used. Will also open a short postmortem for quota tuning.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in place, customer impact reduced, follow-up required.
ops-bot: Metric alert cleared for high 5xx. Monitoring channel will keep an eye for 10m.
